At the opening, the month on record (2026-09-20..2026-10-20) was opened by the paid renewal d2ca5afc, but it ends 2026-10-20 < 2026-10-24, and no renewal row has period_start 2026-10-20 (declines on 2026-10-13/17/19). Unmet.
- The write that opens such a month for an active monthly subscription past its term end is the late monthly renewal. In scope: Mail, monthly, after term end, status active, scheduled_variant none. Its rule carries the sentence "A late monthly renewal is not collected until the charges of the current month carry every seat on the subscription other than the seats of mailboxes deleted and never restored." Opening charge 15 seats + added-seat lines with period_end 2026-10-20 = none, so billed = 15. Seat count 19, idle = 3 deletions (jo, pat, lee) − 1 restore (jo) = 2. 15 < 17, unmet.
- The write that adds seats to the month's charges without changing the seat count is the seat catch-up (Mail, monthly, active). The catch-up rule has no prerequisite sentence.

  - email_ext_annual_conversion (agent) <- email_ext_late_monthly_renewal (user), value_input: credit, converted seats and opening charge.
